# WINDCHIC

> WINDCHIC is an event production and coordination company in Europe for Chinese and international clients: trade shows, business delegations, corporate events, event staff, design, catering, entertainment, audiovisual and China–Europe sourcing, with one Chinese-speaking contact and an operations team on the ground.

> WINDCHIC 是为中国及国际客户提供欧洲活动策划与落地执行的公司：海外参展、商务考察团接待、企业活动、活动人员、设计、餐饮、演出、视听及中欧采购寻源，全程中文对接，欧洲本地团队执行。

> WINDCHIC est une entreprise de production et de coordination d'événements en Europe pour clients chinois et internationaux : salons, délégations d'affaires, événements d'entreprise, staff, design, traiteur, animation, audiovisuel et sourcing Chine–Europe, avec une interlocutrice sinophone et une équipe opérationnelle sur le terrain.

## Key facts / 核心信息

- Website: https://windchic.com (English), https://windchic.com/zh/ (中文), https://windchic.com/fr/ (Français)
- Business: event production, trade-show support, business delegations, event services and China–Europe sourcing in Europe / 欧洲活动策划与落地执行、海外参展服务、商务考察团接待、中欧采购寻源
- For: Chinese and international companies organising events in Europe / 服务对象：在欧洲举办活动或参展的中国及国际企业（出海企业）
- Area: Europe-wide, mainly France, Spain, Italy; missions in Paris, Lyon, Montpellier, Bordeaux, Segovia, Madrid, Barcelona, United Kingdom / 覆盖全欧洲，以法国、西班牙、意大利为主
- Team: Wenjing (Chinese-speaking project lead / 中文项目负责人) and Théo (operations in Europe / 欧洲运营负责人)
- Languages / 工作语言: Chinese 中文, French, English, Spanish, German
- Size: from a 20-guest dinner to a 500-person convention / 20 人晚宴至 500 人大会
- Response: reply within 24 hours, structured proposal within 48 hours / 24 小时内回复，48 小时内出方案
- Partner in China / 国内合作伙伴: KKD Group 东方科德 (Guangdong, 18 years of events)
- Contact: WeChat 微信 Contact-Windchic · WhatsApp/phone +33 7 82 65 40 82 · info@windchic.com

## Services / 服务

- Exhibitions & Events / 展会与活动: Stands, activations, people and production. 展台、品牌活动、人员与制作。
- Specialist Equipment / 专业设备: Technical sourcing, rental and installation. 专业设备寻源、租赁与安装。
- Business Concierge / 商务礼宾: Hospitality, teams, transport and fieldwork. 接待、团队、交通与现场执行。
- China & Europe Sourcing / 中欧采购寻源: Manufacturers, quotations and procurement support. 制造商筛选、报价比较与采购协调。
- Event staff / 活动人员: Hosts, bilingual hostesses, interpreters and crews. 接待、双语礼仪、翻译与执行团队。
- Event design & graphics / 活动设计与视觉: Scenography, decoration, signage and visual identity. 场景设计、布置、标识与视觉形象。
- Catering, wherever you are / 餐饮服务，无论身在何处: Cocktails, gala dinners and buffets with quality caterers. 鸡尾酒会、晚宴与自助餐，甄选优质餐饮商。
- Wedding brunch & celebrations / 婚礼早午餐与庆典: The relaxed day-after brunch your guests will love. 婚礼次日轻松愉快的早午餐。
- Team building & group activities / 团建与团体活动: Experiences that bring teams and delegations together. 凝聚团队与代表团的体验活动。
- Event entertainment / 活动娱乐: DJs, musicians, hosts and interactive animations. DJ、乐手、主持与互动节目。
- Artistic production & shows / 艺术制作与演出: Performers and artists who share their passion. 传递热爱的表演者与艺术家。
- Audiovisual: lighting, sound & video / 视听：灯光、音响与视频: Screens, kiosks, sound systems, lighting and filming. 屏幕、触摸屏、音响、灯光与拍摄。

## Projects / 项目案例

- DJI Enterprise · Segovia, Spain: For its heritage-conservation awards, DJI Enterprise needed ten identical touchscreen kiosks with integrated Windows computers to showcase the winning drone projects delivered, installed and tested on a tight schedule in a hotel venue outside Segovia. Ten matching kiosks, branded and running for the whole event, presenting each award natural and cultural heritage alongside the main stage.
- A Chinese delegation meets French retail / 中国代表团对接法国零售业: We built the programme, arranged the company visits, including Carrefour's headquarters and the distributor Centrale Food, organised meetings in Bordeaux, and handled transport and interpretation from start to finish.
- Live brand activation (Lyon, France · Piscine Global) / 现场品牌活动
- Two containers, ten people, four days (Montpellier, France) / 两个集装箱、十个人、四天
- Specialist tablet sourcing (Madrid, Spain) / 专业平板设备寻源
- MWC travel operations (Barcelona, Spain · MWC 2027) / MWC 差旅统筹
- Multilingual exhibition sales (Paris, France) / 多语种展会销售
